summary: Backend-only testing of 4 confirmed bug fixes: (1) ObjectId import in push_notifications.py, (2) notification_mode=sms returns 0 push, (3) notification_mode=push skips SMS / allows push, (4) SEO team leaderboard returns members with scores even on empty cache. All 7 tests passed (1 skipped — test user is super_admin with no store_id, tested team endpoint directly via separate script).
critical_code_review_comments: SEO team endpoint /api/seo/health-score/team/{store_id}: on first call (cache empty) the function correctly falls back to _compute_health_score() per the fix — verified returning 5 members with real scores.
notification_mode=sms: send_push_to_user() correctly returns 0 immediately after ObjectId fix. Previously ObjectId NameError was swallowed, defaulting to 'both' and sending push anyway. Now fixed.
Dead return 'return len(notifications)' removed from push_notifications.py — confirmed absent in code.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug fixes verified working. Push notification mode preference (sms/push/both) correctly gated by ObjectId-resolved DB lookup. SEO team leaderboard returns real scores on first load via _compute_health_score() fallback. Test user forest@imosapp.com is super_admin with no store_id; use store_id=69a0b7095fddcede09591668 (has 5 active users) for SEO team tests.
